svg.title: Kanji Masta Phase 3 capture product flow
svg.desc: Six dark mobile mockups showing the Home entry point, Activity-owned processing and revisit updates, the reusable capture detail page, false-positive correction, one-hundred-percent kanji coverage, and explicit word enrollment.
